claims.population: As at 2007 the city had an estimated population of 125,594 people.
claims.economy: It now serves as a collecting point for peanuts (groundnuts) and rice and as a major local market centre in millet, sorghum, rice, fish, goats, and cattle. It is the site of a state polytechnic college and a government rice-research station.
claims.health: The oldest hospital in Birnin Kebbi is found to be Sir Yahaya Memorial Hospital. Federal Medical Center can also be found in Birnin Kebbi metropolis.
claims.transport: The city is served by the Sir Ahmadu Bello International Airport.
